# Narcotics and Neuroware
Street drugs are cooked, grown and sold all over the sector, and every one of them is Class 3 contraband. Synthetics can't use them and run neuroware instead, which is at the bottom of this page.
## The drugs
- [bold]Cocaine[/bold] (stimulant): a little faster, stamina comes back quicker, and it takes the edge off pain. The crash is short and tired. - [bold]Crack[/bold] (stimulant): cocaine, stronger and half as long. It hooks you three times as fast and the crash is worse. - [bold]Crystal[/bold] (stimulant): desoxyephedrine in a shard you can smoke. A heavy dose shakes off stuns faster. It has the longest crash of the lot. - [bold]Opium[/bold] (opioid): mild pain relief, and it barely slows you. - [bold]Heroin[/bold] (opioid): a strong painkiller that slows you down, sedates you and makes you nod off. Too much stops your breathing. - [bold]Fentanyl[/bold] (opioid): half again as strong as heroin and out of your blood in seconds. While it is in there you can barely walk, you slur, shake and pass out, and more than 6u poisons and chokes you. What is left afterwards is a few minutes of heroin high. Naloxone clears it like any opioid. Never mix it with dylovene. - [bold]Redline[/bold] (combat): speed, and wounds don't slow you. A heavy dose gives more speed and halves stuns and knockdowns. It strains your heart the whole time, and you collapse when it ends. - [bold]Anvil[/bold] (combat): you take less Brute and Burn damage and can't see your own damage readout, but you move slower. A heavy dose also keeps you out of stamina crit. The damage it held off comes back as Poison when it wears off. - [bold]Chorus[/bold] (psychedelic): the hallucinations of the Lattice without flying out to it. They get worse the deeper you go. Out in the Coda it also lets you feel exotic matter: a violet light on your screen points to the nearest rock that holds some, from further away the deeper the high. Your ship gains Drift half again as fast while you do. - [bold]Halo[/bold] (empathogen): warmth, laughter and a little pain relief. It raises your body temperature, an overdose is a fever that can kill, and the come-down is sad. - [bold]Cannabis and hash[/bold]: THC, as it always was. - [bold]Nicotine[/bold]: a small stamina lift and a habit.
## Taking them
[bold]Lines.[/bold] Use a baggie of powder on a table to lay out a line, then use the line to take it. A mask or helmet over your face blocks it. An empty baggie is crafted from a sheet of plastic. It holds 10u, four lines, of cocaine, heroin, crystal or ephedrine powder, or a few solid drugs: rocks, shards, resin, hash, cannabis, dried shrooms or fentanyl crystals. Click the baggie with a solid, or click a loose solid with the baggie, to put it in. Use the baggie in your hand to take one back out, or use it on a table to set one down when it holds no powder. Examining a baggie up close shows what is tucked inside.
[bold]Bong.[/bold] Craft one from two glass and one plastic. Fill it with at least 5u of water, put a rock, shard, resin, brick or dried leaf in the bowl, light it with anything hot, and use it in hand for a hit. A bowl lasts a few hits. You can see the water in the glass, the load in the bowl, and the ember and smoke while it burns.
[bold]Second-hand smoke.[/bold] Part of anything smoked, from a bong, joint, cigarette or pipe, stays in the air. Whoever breathes the haze nearby gets a little of it, more in a small closed room and next to the smoker, almost none in a big or well-scrubbed one. Internals keep it out.
Everything else goes the usual way: pills, syringes, pipes and joints.
## Highs and crashes
A high has three phases: [bold]light[/bold], [bold]heavy[/bold] and [bold]overdose[/bold]. A popup tells you each time you go deeper or come back up. Your screen, your hearing, your voice and the way chat reads to you all change with the drug and get stronger with each phase. Others hear the difference in how you talk.
A high lasts as long as the drug stays in your blood. A 2.5u line lasts about four minutes, and two last twice as long. Crack, cannabis and the combat drugs clear twice as fast. A crystal shard lasts about as long as two lines.
A fresh dose of cocaine, crack, opium, heroin, Chorus or Halo comes with a [bold]rush[/bold]. For the first minute it hits well above its weight, then settles, so even one line takes you heavy for a moment. The rush never causes an overdose. Only what is in your blood does.
An overdose does real harm, and the body clears the excess quickly, but not quickly enough to be safe.
Heavy on opioids you [bold]nod off[/bold]: every so often your eyes shut for a few seconds. You stay on your feet and can still act, but you can't see and barely move, and people nearby may notice. In an overdose it happens more often and you can pass out.
When the drug drops below a light dose, the [bold]crash[/bold] begins. Most crashes grow with the time you spent high. Taking more pauses a crash but doesn't cancel it. Being on Redline and Anvil at once damages the heart.
A health analyzer's [bold]Conditions[/bold] tab lists every high, crash and habit, the reagents behind each, how long they take to clear and what clears them faster.
## What others see
Anyone who examines you can tell. Up close, with your eyes uncovered, even a light high shows in your face: pinpoint pupils on opioids, blown ones on stimulants, red eyes on cannabis, a flush on Halo or drink. Glasses, a mask or a helmet over the eyes hide that. A heavy high shows in the way you move, from any distance and through a sealed suit, and so does an overdose, a crash up close, and withdrawal once the shakes start. None of it names the drug.
## Flying high
What you are on changes how a ship answers you, more with each phase.
- [bold]Stimulants[/bold]: the ship turns and accelerates a little better. In an overdose your hand jerks the stick. In the crash it handles worse than it ever handled well. - [bold]Opioids[/bold]: the ship answers late and keeps going after you let go. If you nod off, the stick stays where it was until you wake. - [bold]Cannabis[/bold]: soft brakes and a slow turn. - [bold]Alcohol[/bold]: your heading wanders while you fly.
## Ending a high
These clear the drug from the blood. The crash still comes, and so does the Poison Anvil owes.
- [bold]Naloxone[/bold]: opioids. - [bold]Haloperidol[/bold]: stimulants and psychedelics. - [bold]Dylovene[/bold]: Redline and Anvil. - [bold]Psicodine[/bold]: Halo and cannabis. Halo's fever also needs cooling. - [bold]Charcoal[/bold]: any drug, along with every other medicine in the blood.
## Habits
Regular use builds [bold]dependence[/bold], one meter for each family. A light habit fades within the shift. Past halfway it fades four times slower, so a real habit takes an hour or more clean to shake.
Above the halfway mark, going without for five minutes starts [bold]withdrawal[/bold]: cravings first, then shakes, a stamina cap and aches, and for opioids and stimulants, nausea and drowsiness at the worst. Nicotine never gets past cravings. A taste won't end it: you have to get properly high on the same family, and tolerance means that takes more each time. While you are, a habit pays you back with a little stamina. Withdrawal never kills.
Use also builds [bold]tolerance[/bold], up to double. The same dose hits softer, so it takes more to get as high, or to overdose. Tolerance fades slowly while clean. Take your old dose after a long break and it can kill you.
The [bold]Stimulant habit[/bold], [bold]Opioid habit[/bold] and [bold]Smoker[/bold] traits start you with a habit that eases to cravings if you stay clean but never fades, and a cut baggie or a pack of cigarettes.
## Grades
Any reagent can carry a [bold]grade[/bold], from 0 to 100%. Anything from a dispenser is standard grade and shows nothing. Reactions run off their ideal temperature, cheap plants and street cuts come out lower.
A dose at 60% works like 60% of the amount, and the other 40% is impurity that the body takes as Poison. Overdose limits count the working part only, so a weak batch won't overdose you sooner. It will just poison you.
Grade sets the price as well. The price falls faster than the grade: a rock at half grade sells for a quarter, so cutting loses money at the market.
A ChemMaster shows the percentage beside any graded reagent, and so do health analyzers and chemical goggles. A [bold]purity tester[/bold] does the same for any container or item it touches. It prints at a protolathe or medical techfab, and the dealers carry it too.
[bold]Cutting.[/bold] Mix flour into cocaine or heroin in a beaker and it turns into more powder, a unit for a unit, at a lower grade: 10u at 80% and 10u of flour make 20u at 40%. Only a reading shows the difference.
## Cooking
Grind coca leaves for coca alkaloid and opium poppy pods for opium. Press three dried cannabis leaves into a hash brick from the crafting menu. The liquid recipes are also listed in the Chemicals guide, under Narcotics.
Each reaction has a temperature that gives full grade, and it moves by a few kelvin every shift, so test a small batch before you commit the lot. The further off it runs, the lower the grade, down to 40% at the edge of its range, and the product can't come out better than what went in. A reaction happens the moment its last condition is met, so bring the mix to temperature before the last ingredient goes in.
- [bold]Cocaine:[/bold] 3 coca alkaloid, 1 sodium carbonate, 1 acetone. Above 310K, best at 330K. - [bold]Crack:[/bold] 5 cocaine, 1 sodium carbonate, 1 water. Above 370K, best at 385K. One rock per 5u of cocaine. - [bold]Heroin:[/bold] 2 opium, 1 vinegar, 1 ammonia. Above 330K, best at 350K. - [bold]Opium resin:[/bold] chill opium below 270K, best at 250K, then add a splash of water to set it. One lump per 5u. - [bold]Crystal:[/bold] chill desoxyephedrine below 240K, best at 220K, then add a splash of acetone to set it. One shard per 5u. - [bold]Redline:[/bold] ephedrine, phosphorus and plasma above 340K make the base, best at 360K. Then 2 base, 1 epinephrine and 1 iron, best at 300K. - [bold]Anvil:[/bold] bicaridine, silicon and lithium above 320K make the base, best at 340K. Then 2 base, 1 tramadol and 1 mercury, best at 290K. - [bold]Halo:[/bold] happiness, oil and potassium above 300K make the base, best at 310K. Then 2 base, 1 ammonia and 1 copper, best at 340K. - [bold]Chorus:[/bold] Lattice residue (ground exotic matter), space drugs and ethanol below 290K make the base, best at 270K. Then 2 base, 1 mindbreaker toxin and 1 iodine, best at 310K.
## Neuroware
A synthetic's brain doesn't register chemicals, so its drugs are programs. Use a [bold]data stick[/bold] on a synthetic to load its program: two seconds on yourself, four on someone else, and they get a warning. An organic brain has no port.
A program gives the same high, crash and habit as the drug it copies, shown on the optics as its own kind of glitch:
- [bold]Whiteline[/bold]: cocaine. - [bold]Null Loop[/bold]: heroin. - [bold]Burst[/bold]: crystal. - [bold]Damper[/bold]: Anvil. - [bold]Choir.sig[/bold]: Chorus. - [bold]Idle[/bold]: cannabis. - [bold]Halo[/bold] and [bold]Redline[/bold] go by their own names. On a synthetic, Redline costs charge and heat instead of the heart.
Sticks have [bold]integrity[/bold], which works like grade. A weak stick delivers less, and the missing part makes the program glitch with brief stuns, forced beeps, scrambled speech and fake faults. Using a loaded stick on a blank copies it at 85% of the original's integrity, with one load. The original loses nothing, so a build spreads as far as you have blanks, a little worse each generation. Street copies are several generations down.
Blank and loaded sticks turn up in maintenance and salvage, and the dealers sell both.
A synthetic with the Wolfmed HUD sees what is running as fault lines. A [bold]reboot[/bold] from the chassis panel kills every running program and ends the high, but not the habit.
## The law
Possession is a citation and trafficking an impound. The drug is the contraband, whatever it is in: a beaker, syringe, pill or storage tank of it is marked and sold the same as a baggie, and packing it in a crate changes nothing. Loading neuroware into someone who didn't agree to it is a crime against their person.
A baggie of cocaine sells for about fifteen hundred at full grade, and a pristine stick for more. Selling any of it through cargo tells security where it was sold, and the money finds its way to the Ashfall Reavers: enough of it brings their next reinforcements and their spread forward. The street dealers and the Reaver runners don't ask.
